mapper.sql: user_id, `date`, total_kcal, total_carbohydrate, total_protein, total_fat, total_sugar, total_sodium, diet_score_avg, diet_score_sum, meal_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO user_daily_nutrition ( user_id, `date`, total_kcal, total_carbohydrate, total_protein, total_fat, total_sugar, total_sodium, diet_score_avg, diet_score_sum, meal_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{date}, #{totalKcal}, #{totalCarbohydrate}, #{totalProtein}, #{totalFat}, #{totalSugar}, #{totalSodium}, #{dietScoreAvg}, #{dietScoreSum}, #{mealCount},
#{createdAt} NOW() ,
#{updatedAt} NOW()
)
mapper.update: UPDATE user_daily_nutrition SET total_kcal = #{totalKcal}, total_carbohydrate = #{totalCarbohydrate}, total_protein = #{totalProtein}, total_fat = #{totalFat}, total_sugar = #{totalSugar}, total_sodium = #{totalSodium}, diet_score_avg = #{dietScoreAvg}, diet_score_sum = #{dietScoreSum}, meal_count = #{mealCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND `date` = #{date}
mapper.select: SELECT d.user_id AS userId, DATE(d.`date`) AS `date`, SUM(d.total_kcal) AS totalKcal, SUM(d.total_carbohydrate) AS totalCarbohydrate, SUM(d.total_protein) AS totalProtein, SUM(d.total_fat) AS totalFat, SUM(d.total_sugar) AS totalSugar, SUM(d.total_sodium) AS totalSodium, AVG(ds.score) AS dietScoreAvg, SUM(ds.score) AS dietScoreSum, COUNT(d.id) AS mealCount FROM diet d LEFT JOIN diet_score ds ON d.id = ds.diet_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND DATE(d.`date`) = #{date} AND d.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY d.user_id, DATE(d.`date`)
